entities.name: PMID:34461969
observations: A 2021 retrospective analysis identified three clinical ARDS phenotypes and reported phenotype-by-randomized-fluid-management interaction for 60-day mortality (P=0.01); retrieved summary states conservative management benefited phenotype II with opposite direction in phenotype III.

This is a three-clinical-phenotype analysis, not the conventional two-class hypo-/hyperinflammatory latent-subphenotype analysis; subgroup effect estimates were not available in the retrieved evidence.
